description: This Java source file defines an abstract class `CollectionPart<E>`, which acts as a wrapper for a partial collection, storing additional metadata such as the position and size of the collection segment, as well as whether the total number of elements is exact or approximate.

classes.name: CollectionPart
classes.description: An abstract class representing a segment or part of a collection with metadata about its position and size.

methods.name: CollectionPart
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the collection part with the provided collection and metadata values.

methods.name: getCollection
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the actual collection segment.

methods.name: getFirstElement
methods.description: Returns the index of the first element in the collection segment.

methods.name: getMaxElements
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of elements in the collection segment.

methods.name: getTotalElements
methods.description: Returns the total number of elements in the full collection.

methods.name: isTotalElementsExact
methods.description: Indicates whether the total number of elements is known exactly.
